sources.what: Official online edge-to-board selector (handleRequest.php brand/decor lists + results pages with edgeResult JSON): Galoplast edge decor code, name, collection (Standard/Galodesign/High Gloss), sizes (thickness x width) and the board decor it is matched to, for all 24 board brands offered (EGGER, Kronospan, LAMARTY, Увадрев, Evogloss (Kastamonu), AGT, Swiss Krono (Kronostar), BY SPAN, etc.). 7064 rows, 1521 board decors.
sources.termsNote: No terms of use / copyright restriction found on the site (only a personal-data privacy policy and cookie notice). The selector is a public service advertised for customers.

sources.what: Statement that Galoplast edges (Standard, Galodesign collections) are PVC edges for Kronospan/Egger/Lamarty boards -> material=pvc for Standard/Galodesign; High Gloss collection material not stated -> unknown

Official Hranipex comparative tables (RU site): board decor (+structure) -> Hranipex ABS/melamine edge article (HD/HU number), name and published sizes (width x thickness). Tables used: https://www.hranipex.com/ru/comparative-tables/egger-decorative-collection-26/, https://www.hranipex.com/ru/comparative-tables/egger/, https://www.hranipex.com/ru/comparative-tables/kronodesign-global-collection-3-0/, https://www.hranipex.com/ru/comparative-tables/kronodesign-local-collections/, https://www.hranipex.com/ru/comparative-tables/lamarty-ru/, https://www.hranipex.com/ru/comparative-tables/agt-turkey/, https://www.hranipex.com/ru/comparative-tables/kastamonu-romania/, https://www.hranipex.com/ru/comparative-tables/kastamonu-italy/, https://www.hranipex.com/ru/comparative-tables/swiss-krono-ua/, https://www.hranipex.com/ru/comparative-tables/byspan/, https://www.hranipex.com/ru/comparative-tables/arkopa/
sources.termsNote: Commercial terms (GTC) cover sales only; footer says 'Copyright HRANIPEX a.s.'; no clause forbidding reuse of catalogue/product data found.

skipped.reason: interior.rehau.com and www.rehau.com return 403 (Akamai) to curl; the edgeband search www.rehau.com/collection redirects to '/edgeband-search-not-available'. WebFetch of the Egger page shows no match table, only a link to the unavailable search. No public match-list PDF found.
Distributor, not a manufacturer; site answers curl with a Yandex SmartCaptcha page. Not bypassed.
Dealer (Хаус Маркет) / docplayer re-publications of Hranipex tables; used Hranipex's own comparative tables instead.
Egger 2017-19, Egger 2020-22, Kronospan Global Collection 2018-22 tables deliberately not used (superseded collections); Kastamonu/Swiss Krono only via tables listed in sources.
Out of scope for this slug (collected by another agent).
Dropped in v2 on request: Uvadrev's own catalog edges are covered by another file. v1 (edges-v1.json) still holds them and the PDF name-based matches.

notes: v2: one record per edge code + material + ONE thickness; widthsMm = widths published for that thickness (Galoplast selector rows and Hranipex per-size strings are both explicit thickness×width pairs, so unpairedEdgeCodes is empty). Hranipex records with no published sizes (32 codes) keep empty thicknessesMm/widthsMm. Hranipex size variants (Preglued, AdvE/Hot-Air) are not distinguished; widths are merged per thickness. Records: 3275 ({'Galoplast': 955, 'Hranipex': 2320}); distinct codes: Galoplast 402, Hranipex 1144. Matches (counted per record): 8627. Match manufacturer names normalised: Egger, Kronospan, Kastamonu (incl. Galoplast 'Evogloss (Kastamonu)'), Lamarty, Увадрев, SWISS KRONO (incl. Kronostar RU and Swiss Krono UA tables), AGT. Uvadrev own edges dropped (see skipped; kept in edges-v1.json). Decor-code parsing and name-only decors: Galoplast publishes the board decor as a free string ('U222 ST9 Крем бежевый', 'Альби Полуночно-Синий 5994 SU', 'Айконик'); code = first alphanumeric token with a digit, structureCode = following short Latin token(s) (ST9, SU, PE, Supramat...). Where the board maker uses names only (Lamarty, NORDECO, ЮГРА, ВМДОК, KARELIA partly), decorCode = the decor name as written by the edge maker (Hranipex writes Lamarty names transliterated, e.g. 'Dub galiano'). Hranipex titles: first token = decor code, rest = structure as written (e.g. '3001 Super Matt'). Not covered: REHAU (blocked/search unavailable), Döllken/Surteco, Kromag, Tece, MAAG, Renolit, AGT's own edges.
